title: Mimikyu (Pokémon)
text:
Mimikyu (Japanese: ミミッキュ Mimikkyu) is a dual-type Ghost/Fairy Pokémon introduced in Generation VII.
While it is not known to evolve into or from any other Pokémon, Mimikyu changes from its Disguised Form into its Busted Form when it is hit by an move.


== Biology ==

Mimikyu is a small Pokémon whose true body is almost entirely concealed beneath an old rag. At only 0.2 m (8 in) tall, it is one of the shortest Ghost-type Pokémon, though its disguise increases its apparent height to approximately 0.56 m (1 ft 10 in). Mimikyu's Pokédex data records its height without its disguise. Beneath the hem of its costume, a fringe of its amorphous lower body is visible. Mimikyu's eyes can be seen through holes in the disguise as beady black dots, though the animated series depicts them as purple. When angered, its eyes glow yellow. It can also extend a long, black, claw-like appendage from beneath the rag. The disguise itself resembles a Pikachu, consisting of a yellow cloth with black-tipped ears. Its face appears to be crudely drawn with crayons, featuring black eyes, red cheeks, and a squiggly black mouth. Mimikyu carries a small stick shaped like a lightning bolt to imitate Pikachu's tail. The head of the costume is hollow and can be used to store objects.
A special Mimikyu in Alola acts as the Totem Pokémon for Acerola's trial in an abandoned Thrifty Megamart. This Mimikyu possesses Z-Power, an energy that originates from Ultra Wormholes and takes the form of a golden, flaring aura. The reward for defeating Totem Mimikyu and completing the trial is a Ghostium Z.
Mimikyu is the only known Pokémon capable of using the Z-Move Let's Snuggle Forever. It is also the only known Pokémon that can have Disguise as an Ability.

		
			
			
		
		
			
			
		
		
			
			
		


=== Forms ===
Mimikyu has two forms: Disguised Form and Busted Form.


==== Disguised Form ====
In its Disguised Form, Mimikyu's costume remains intact and maintains its Pikachu-like appearance. The rag stands upright, concealing Mimikyu's true form from view. Only its eyes, the lower fringe of its body, and occasionally its claw-like appendage are visible beneath the disguise.
Mimikyu is a silent, lonely Pokémon who disguises itself as a Pikachu in the hopes of making friends with people and Pokémon because of the rising popularity of Pikachu-styled merchandise from two decades ago. Despite its attempts to befriend others by appearing harmless, its cloth unfortunately only ends up making it look creepier. Its relationship with Pikachu can vary between individuals and canons, with some being antagonistic, as seen in Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon, or friendly, as shown in the A Mimikyu Bedtime Story short. Its height in its Disguised Form is similar to Pikachu's. Mimikyu lives in dark places because it becomes sick when it is exposed to sunlight, so it is rumored that this is why it wears its covering. Mimikyu is always covered by its disguise, so its actual appearance is unknown. However, glimpses of it have been seen, such as its claw, its underside, and its eyes. It is believed that seeing its true form from underneath the cloth will be afflicted with a mysterious illness, so the people of Alola dare not try to peek. A scholar who saw underneath Mimikyu's rag was so horrified that they died from shock. A Pokémon Trainer who accidentally saw its true form due to a gust of wind and a curious scientist who wanted to know what it looks like were unfortunate enough to encounter a similar fate, with the former dying painfully that night and the latter succumbing to a mysterious illness. Mimikyu will become agitated and violently stop anyone from attempting to look underneath its rag. Until recent times, it was initially thought by humans to be just a ghost wearing a cloth. As mentioned in Pokémon Sleep, Mimikyu mimics Pikachu to the point of even sleeping like it.


==== Busted Form ====
When Mimikyu's disguise is damaged, it shifts to its Busted Form. The costume's head droops limply backward, exposing that the Pikachu-like appearance is merely a disguise. If the damage is severe enough to tear the rag, shadowy vapors emerge from the concealed body hidden within the costume.
Mimikyu changes into its Busted Form when it is hit by an attack and its neck breaks, causing it to slump over and no longer convincingly resemble a Pikachu. It is known to feel deep sadness when its true form is revealed, though it is likely that it is not actually in pain despite its broken neck. Ordinarily, the rag it wears allows Mimikyu to avoid attacks. Mimikyu will attempt to keep up its disguise, even if its rag is broken, but if it does get damaged, Mimikyu will spend all night patching it in front of a mirror as if its life depends on it. Repairing the rag correctly is often difficult for Mimikyu, so it cries a lot on the inside. It then seeks revenge on the one that damaged it, fearing that its true identity could have been exposed. Unforgiving, Mimikyu will take down the culprit even at the risk of costing its own life in the process. It will never forget the person who damaged its rag for as long as it is still alive.
